_about: AgenticScientist FINAL Run #3 'D-Day' (2026-11-24 -> deadline 25 Nov 23:59 AoE = Thu 26 Nov 12:59 CET). Same design as Run #2 (3-way premium researcher cycle GPT-6.2 Sol / Claude Opus 5.5 / Gemini 4 Neon High, quota fallback chains, test-aligned dev & holdout splits) with two harness fixes for researcher sessions that ended without hypothesis.json: (1) Gemini 4 Neon High gets a 2 h research limit (research_timeout_s, kept when it stands in for another model) and every researcher prompt states its real wall-clock limit and a draft deadline; (2) a session that still ends without hypothesis.json gets one automatic 25-min wrap-up call (rescue) by the same model that turns its digest into hypothesis.json + implementation instead of a skip. Seed = Run #2's automated finalization (seed_dday).

acceptance.rule: screen one seed pair; confirm with all eight paired evaluations; accept when the proxy or changed board clears the margin with a one-sided 95% lower bound, subject to board and condition loss limits

guard._note: guard_embryo_e80 is now directly in Embryo Dev (weight 0.65) alongside embryo_early (0.35), and heart/temporal/embryo all select via test-aligned holdouts.

directives.w0: The D-Day seed already has 5000 real cells, heart-chamber conditioning, coarse 3-lineage maturity selection, and prevalence-calibrated Qiu late-anchor pseudobulk continuation. Push toward the 82-84 T1 leaders: (1) lineage-specific (not just global) Qiu late-anchor maturation direction on cardiomyocytes/endocardium/other-cardiac; (2) unbalanced partial OT / kNN-transport donor reweighting (OT50U / CT3_k150); (3) covariance/variogram-preserving expression refinement and principled heart-chamber composition growth (especially cardiomyocyte maturation without hurting mmd_u or variogram).
directives.w1: The D-Day seed already exports 25,179 organ-resident real cells with detached-vessel relocation (fixed d2_shape), bounded organ growth, and saturating detection-depth thinning, plus Run #2 w1_c02 bounded fetal maturation (heart_maturation.py, already uses context['external'] and context['external_spatial']). Push toward the 75-77 Heart leaders (PeacyBlose25 CXB_KBULKO30_N25179_R5105): (1) bounded pseudobulk expression extrapolation (BULKO20/KBULKO30) on detected panel entries using both the input trend and context['external'] (Feulner E14.5/E16.5 dissected hearts, calibrated per gene); (2) late-stage neighbourhood/composition refinement using context['external_spatial'] (Slide-seq E14.5/E15.5) and kNN-coupled local expression; (3) exact organ size/growth calibration targeting the E12.5 dissected heart envelope without hurting d2_shape or neighborhood_mmd.
directives.w2: The D-Day seed keeps the clean unstretched native nearer-bracket scaffold (5000 rows, occupancy ~100 on test) and local-field one-to-one donor matching. Both guard_embryo_e80 (E7.25+E8.25_late -> E8.0) and embryo_early are now in Dev with scale and native_occupancy >= 0.92 in Dev (>= 0.97 on E7.75 test) enforced. Push toward the 80-81 Embryo leaders: (1) Nyström / multi-scale spectral neighbourhood matching and optimal transport coupling (keeping native_occupancy >= 0.97 on E7.75 and preserving interpolated RMS radius); (2) calibrated CP10k-log midpoint pseudobulk + spread correction without over-thinning deep stages; (3) bracket-informed cell-state weighting using context['external'] (Extended Mouse Atlas E6.5-E7.25 and E8.0-E9.5).
directives.w3: The D-Day seed already ships the verified GO-weighted d230 developmental-delay mixer (fires cleanly on broad signalling regulators like Ctnnb1 and narrow GO modules like Mab21l2) plus the DNA-TF exposure-calibrated model. Forward-time mef2c_e85 (E7.75+E8.5 -> E8.5) is now fixed in Dev, and finalization checks an unseen non-cardiac knockout veto. Push toward the 77-80 T3 leaders: (1) use context['coexpr_prior'] (NEW: 100% WT Qiu 2024 <=E9.0 signed gene-to-panel correlation, both global corr_all and within-lineage corr_within!) and context['gene_embeddings'] (Geneformer-V2-104M, unused in Run #1!) + vetted GO topology to predict signed gene-specific DE direction and affected-module scores for off-panel knockouts; (2) refine real-cell developmental delay + lineage-specific response direction so DE recovery, direction, mmd_u, and variogram rise together across ALL knockout genes without hurting any gene group or non-cardiac knockouts.
